strings.zh: 對於過去用類固醇 / Tacrolimus 反應不佳的臉部白斑，Ruxolitinib 是顯著進步。
strings.en: For facial vitiligo with poor response to corticosteroids or tacrolimus, ruxolitinib is a significant advance.

strings.zh: 外用 Ruxolitinib + NB-UVB(臉部、軀幹)
口服 OMP + NB-UVB(快速進展型)
分節型(SV)更適合手術 — 預後較好
strings.en: Segmental (SV) responds better to surgery — better prognosis

strings.zh: 非分節型若已經對其他治療反應差，可考慮
strings.en: Non-segmental can be considered if other treatments have failed

strings.zh: 自體免疫造成的皮膚色素脫失
2022 年外用 Ruxolitinib（Opzelura,JAK 抑制劑）獲 FDA 核准
strings.en: Topical ruxolitinib (Opzelura, JAK inhibitor) received FDA approval in 2022

strings.zh: 白斑是後天自體免疫疾病
strings.en: Vitiligo is an acquired autoimmune disease

strings.zh: 不會傳染，但有家族傾向
strings.en: Not contagious, but with familial predisposition

strings.zh: 邊界清晰、大小不一的色素脫失斑塊
strings.en: Sharply demarcated depigmented patches of varying size

strings.zh: 區分 SV 與 NSV 對判斷預後和選擇治療至關重要
strings.en: Distinguishing SV from NSV is critical for prognosis and treatment selection

strings.zh: 臨床觀察 + 伍氏燈檢查
中高強度外用皮質類固醇
口服低脈衝皮質類固醇（Oral Mini-Pulse, OMP）
合併治療優於單一治療
strings.en: Combination therapy is superior to monotherapy

strings.zh: 活動性 vs 穩定性 — 治療選擇的關鍵分野(TDA 2024)
strings.en: Active vs stable — the key dividing line for treatment selection (TDA 2024)
"Is the vitiligo still expanding right now?"
Do not perform surgery during the active phase

strings.zh: 每週 2 次外用 Calcineurin inhibitor 或外用皮質類固醇
strings.en: Twice-weekly topical calcineurin inhibitor or topical corticosteroid

strings.zh: 52 週時 50% 病人達到 ≥ 75% 臉部色素再生（F-VASI 75）
strings.en: At 52 weeks, 50% of patients achieved ≥ 75% facial repigmentation (F-VASI 75)

strings.zh: 狀態穩定的白斑病灶可使用手術方式治療
strings.en: Surgical therapy can be considered for stable vitiligo lesions
Disease must be stable for at least 1 year

strings.zh: 非培養表皮細胞懸液移植（Non-cultured Epidermal Cell Suspension, NCES）
負壓水泡表皮移植（Suction blister grafting）
細胞培養移植（Cultured melanocyte transfer）
沒有黑色素保護，容易曬傷
strings.en: No melanin protection — prone to sunburn

strings.zh: 甲狀腺疾病、Type 1 糖尿病、紅斑性狼瘡、惡性貧血、Addison's disease
strings.en: Thyroid disease, type 1 diabetes, lupus, pernicious anemia, Addison's disease

strings.zh: 慢性、可治療但無法快速根治
strings.en: chronic, treatable but not quickly curable

strings.zh: 局限型用外用藥（Ruxolitinib 是目前最強）、廣泛型用 NB-UVB、活動性快速進展用口服 OMP、穩定後合併光療提升療效、長期維持治療避免復發、穩定病灶可考慮手術
strings.en: Localized → topical (ruxolitinib is currently strongest); widespread → NB-UVB; rapidly progressive active → oral OMP; once stable, combine with phototherapy for enhanced efficacy; long-term maintenance prevents recurrence; stable lesions may consider surgical grafting

strings.zh: 白斑臨床治療共識（2024 年）
自體免疫色素脫失、Ruxolitinib JAK 時代
strings.en: Autoimmune depigmentation, the ruxolitinib JAK era

strings.zh: 青少年到成人，夏天好發
strings.en: Adolescents to adults, more common in summer

strings.zh: 進展 1-2 年後穩定，色素再生反應較差，可考慮手術
strings.en: Stabilizes after 1–2 years of progression; poorer repigmentation response; surgery is often considered

strings.zh: 雙側對稱，常見口周、四肢、伸展側、對磨皺褶
strings.en: Bilateral symmetric, commonly perioral, extremities, extensor surfaces, intertriginous folds

strings.zh: 慢性反覆，治療反應視部位而定
strings.en: Chronic relapsing course; treatment response varies by site

strings.zh: 單一小斑塊或黏膜白斑
strings.en: Single small patch or mucosal vitiligo

strings.zh: 可能日後轉為 SV / NSV
strings.en: May later evolve into SV or NSV

strings.zh: 所有類型，病灶區域較小
每天 1 次，連續 2-3 個月評估，間歇使用避免皮膚萎縮
strings.en: Once daily, reassess after 2–3 months; intermittent use to avoid atrophy

strings.zh: 所有類型，尤其臉部、頸部、皺褶處（類固醇怕副作用）
strings.en: All types, especially face, neck, and folds (where steroid AEs are a concern)

strings.zh: 每天 2 次，可長期使用
strings.en: Twice daily; suitable for long-term use

strings.zh: 每天 2 次，持續至少 24 週
strings.en: Twice daily for at least 24 weeks

strings.zh: 第一線，所有類型，廣泛型
每週 2-3 次，持續 6-12 個月
第一線，局限型（臉部、頸部、軀幹）
每週 2 次，光劑量精準靶向
strings.en: Twice weekly with precision-targeted light dosing

strings.zh: 第一線，Dexamethasone 2.5 mg 一週給 2 天連續
strings.en: First-line; dexamethasone 2.5 mg on 2 consecutive days per week

strings.zh: 第一線替代，類固醇禁忌時
strings.en: First-line alternative when steroids are contraindicated

strings.zh: JAK1 / JAK2 抑制劑 — 阻斷自體免疫攻擊黑色素細胞的訊號路徑
strings.en: JAK1 / JAK2 inhibitor — blocks autoimmune attack signaling on melanocytes

strings.zh: 每天 2 次薄塗於白斑病灶，持續至少 24 週
strings.en: Apply thinly twice daily to vitiligo lesions for at least 24 weeks

strings.zh: 用藥處輕度發紅、痤瘡、搔癢
strings.en: Mild redness, acne, itching at application site
Self-pay in Taiwan, ~NT$ 4,000–6,000 per 60 g tube

strings.en: ≤ 12 years (not currently approved), widespread > 10% BSA, active severe infection, pregnancy/lactation
